scenarios.name: alt-cost-life-and-blue-card-counters
scenarios.why: The alternative cost is paying 1 life and exiling a blue card from hand. Seat 0 has Counterspell (blue) to exile, so with no mana the alternative is payable: it counters seat 0's own Lightning Bolt, seat 0 drops to 19, the Bolt is countered.

scenarios.name: alt-cost-needs-a-blue-card
scenarios.why: Only Force of Will itself is blue and it is the spell being cast, not a card in hand: with no other blue card to exile and no mana in the pool, neither the alternative nor the mana cost is payable, so the cast is not offered.

scenarios.name: mana-cost-path-counters-without-paying-life
scenarios.why: The mana cost {3}{U}{U} can be paid instead of the alternative: with two blue and three generic in the pool, Force of Will counters the Bolt without exiling a card or paying life.
